summary: ServisFirst Bancshares filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, announcing that its board approved an inaugural stock repurchase program authorizing up to two million shares of common stock through December 31, 2027. Repurchases may occur in the open market at prevailing prices or in privately negotiated transactions; no price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The program signals board confidence in capital strength and long-term growth. As a bank holding company, buybacks remain subject to regulatory capital and approval considerations. Watch execution pace, capital ratios, and any regulatory constraints affecting repurchase capacity.
